# AetherQuant — Programmatic Finance & Causal Discovery API

> AetherQuant provides empirical quantitative market signals, Convergent Cross Mapping (CCM) causality discovery, and persistent homology state-space reconstructions for institutional alpha generation.

## Offerings & Products
- [API Documentation](https://aetherquant.cloud/docs.html): RESTful APIs for causal sentiment feeds, CCM d-separation metrics, and TDA regime shifts.
- [Pro Tier](https://aetherquant.cloud/#pricing): $250/month for 50,000 requests/month, high-frequency sentiment, and anonymized IP telemetry.

## Key Technical Specifications
- Algorithms: Convergent Cross Mapping (CCM), PC-DAG Causal Discovery, Vietoris-Rips Persistent Homology.
- Compliance & Safety: Certified out-of-distribution bounds via Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO).
- Endpoints: `POST /api/v1/sentiment`, `GET /api/v1/causal/ccm`.
